html:
A Liberian rebel leader who started the civil war in 1989, was elected president in 1997 and was forced out in 2003.

He had worked under Samuel Doe and fled to the United States, escaping from a jail there in 1985. His National Patriotic Front of Liberia controlled most of the country through the war. As president he backed the Revolutionary United Front in Sierra Leone in exchange for diamonds. Facing rebels and a UN-backed indictment, he went into exile in Nigeria in August 2003. Arrested in 2006, he was convicted in 2012 by the Special Court for Sierra Leone and sentenced to 50 years.
